d:
Aaj Chef Sanjeev Kapoor ke saath hone wala hai ek crazy Mystery Box Challenge! 4 teams ko mile 11 mystery ingredients aur sirf 90 minutes mein banani hain 3 dishes!
Lekin challenge yahin khatam nahi hota… pantry band hone ka unexpected twist, crazy ingredient combinations aur time ka pressure sabki cooking skills ka asli test lene wala hai! Chocolate aur chicken jaise combinations se lekar pettha se bani winning dish tak, is challenge mein kya kya hua, dekhiye poora food adventure.
